io.writer

Class WriteWorkbook

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.writer.AbstractWorkbook
      • io.writer.WriteWorkbook
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    ExcelWritable, Writable, java.lang.AutoCloseable
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    AppendWorkbook

    public class WriteWorkbook
extends AbstractWorkbook
    Provides an implementation of ExcelWritable for creating and writing entries to an Excel workbook using the Apache POI library. The workbook can be created in either the binary XLS format or the XML-based XLSX format.

    Change log:

    • Created on 2 November 2021
    • Updated to inherit the ExcelWritable implementation via AbstractWorkbook
    Since:
    2 November 2021
    Version:
    0.6
    Author:
    Trevor Maggs

      • addSheet

        protected void addSheet()
                 throws TabularDataException
        Creates and adds a worksheet using the current worksheet name.

        If a worksheet with that name already exists, a numeric suffix is appended incrementally until a unique name is found.

        Specified by:
        addSheet in class AbstractWorkbook
        Throws:
        TabularDataException - if the workbook has not been opened
